blocks.text: Seven Holy Martyrs & Ss. Rufina & Secunda

blocks.chantTranslation:
\V. O God, come to my assistance.//\R. O Lord, make haste to help me.
Glory be...

All the Saints endured//such great torments,
that they might confidently attain//the palm of martyrdom!
_Ps. 98_  The Lord has reigned, //let the peoples tremble:
he who sits upon the cherubim, //let the earth be moved.

blocks.text:
1. Dóminus in Sion magnus: * et excélsus super omnes pópulos.
  2. Confiteántur nómini tuo magno: quóniam terríbile, et sanctum est: * et honor regis iudícium díligit.
  3. Tu parásti directiónes: * iudícium et iustítiam in Jacob tu fecísti.
  4. Exaltáte Dóminum Deum nostrum, et adoráte scabéllum pedum eius: * quóniam sanctum est.
  5. Móyses et Aaron in sacerdótibus eius: * et Sámuel inter eos, qui ínvocant nomen eius:
  6. Invocábant Dóminum, et ipse exaudiébat eos: * in colúmna nubis loquebátur ad eos.
  7. Custodiébant testimónia eius: * et præcéptum quod dedit illis.
  8. Dómine, Deus noster, tu exaudiébas eos: * Deus, tu propítius fuísti eis, et ulcíscens in omnes adinventiónes eórum.
  9. Exaltáte Dóminum Deum nostrum, et adoráte in monte sancto eius: * quóniam sanctus Dóminus Deus noster.
  10. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
  11. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
blocks.translation:
1. The Lord is great in Sion, * and high above all peoples.
  2. Let them confess your great name, for it is terrible and holy, * and the honour of the king loves justice.
  3. You have prepared right judgments: * you have done judgment and justice in Jacob.
  4. Exalt the Lord our God, and adore his footstool, * for it is holy.
  5. Moses and Aaron among his priests, * and Samuel among those who call upon his name:
  6. They called upon the Lord, and he heard them: * he spoke to them in the pillar of the cloud.
  7. They kept his testimonies, * and the commandment which he gave them.
  8. O Lord our God, you heard them: * O God, you were merciful to them, though taking vengeance upon all their inventions.
  9. Exalt the Lord our God, and adore on his holy mountain, * for the Lord our God is holy.
  10. Glory be...

blocks.chantTranslation:
All the Saints endured//such great torments,
that they might confidently attain//the palm of martyrdom!

Bearing the palm,//the Saints have come to the kingdom;
they have deserved crowns of glory from the hand of God.
_Ps. 142 (a)_  Lord, hear my prayer: †//give ear to my supplication in your truth: hear me in your justice.

blocks.text:
1. Et non intres in iudícium cum servo tuo: * quia non iustificábitur in conspéctu tuo omnis vivens.
  2. Quia persecútus est inimícus ánimam meam: * humiliávit in terra vitam meam.
  3. Collocávit me in obscúris sicut mórtuos sǽculi: † et anxiátus est super me spíritus meus, * in me turbátum est cor meum.
  4. Memor fui diérum antiquórum, † meditátus sum in ómnibus opéribus tuis: * in factis mánuum tuárum meditábar.
  5. Expándi manus meas ad te: * ánima mea sicut terra sine aqua tibi.
  6. Velóciter exáudi me, Dómine: * defécit spíritus meus.
  7. Non avértas fáciem tuam a me: * et símilis ero descendéntibus in lacum.
  8. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
  9. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
blocks.translation:
1. And enter not into judgment with your servant: * for no living man shall be justified in your sight.
  2. For the enemy has persecuted my soul: * he has brought my life down to the earth.
  3. He has made me dwell in darkness as those long dead: † and my spirit is in anguish within me, * my heart is troubled within me.
  4. I remembered the days of old, † I meditated on all your works: * I pondered the works of your hands.
  5. I stretched forth my hands to you: * my soul is as a land without water before you.
  6. Hasten to hear me, O Lord: * my spirit has failed.
  7. Turn not away your face from me: * lest I become like those who go down into the pit.
  8. Glory be...

blocks.chantTranslation:
Bearing the palm,//the Saints have come to the kingdom;
they have deserved crowns of glory from the hand of God.

The bodies of the Saints//were buried in peace,
and their names shall live for ever.
_Ps. 84_  You have blessed your land, O Lord: you have turned away//the captivity of Jacob.

blocks.text:
1. Remisísti iniquitátem plebis tuæ: * operuísti ómnia peccáta eórum.
  2. Mitigásti omnem iram tuam: * avertísti ab ira indignatiónis tuæ.
  3. Convérte nos, Deus, salutáris noster: * et avérte iram tuam a nobis.
  4. Numquid in ætérnum irascéris nobis? * aut exténdes iram tuam a generatióne in generatiónem?
  5. Deus, tu convérsus vivificábis nos: * et plebs tua lætábitur in te.
  6. Osténde nobis, Dómine, misericórdiam tuam: * et salutáre tuum da nobis.
  7. Audiam quid loquátur in me Dóminus Deus: * quóniam loquétur pacem in plebem suam.
  8. Et super sanctos suos: * et in eos, qui convertúntur ad cor.
  9. Verúmtamen prope timéntes eum salutáre ipsíus: * ut inhábitet glória in terra nostra.
  10. Misericórdia, et véritas obviavérunt sibi: * iustítia, et pax osculátæ sunt.
  11. Véritas de terra orta est: * et iustítia de cælo prospéxit.
  12. Etenim Dóminus dabit benignitátem: * et terra nostra dabit fructum suum.
  13. Justítia ante eum ambulábit: * et ponet in via gressus suos.
  14. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
  15. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
blocks.translation:
1. You have forgiven the iniquity of your people: * you have covered all their sins.
  2. You have mitigated all your anger: * you have turned away from the wrath of your indignation.
  3. Turn us again, O God our Saviour: * and turn away your anger from us.
  4. Will you be angry with us for ever? * or will you extend your wrath from generation to generation?
  5. O God, you will turn again and bring us to life: * and your people shall rejoice in you.
  6. Show us, O Lord, your mercy: * and grant us your salvation.
  7. I will hear what the Lord God will speak in me: * for he will speak peace unto his people,
  8. And to his saints: * and to those who are turned to him in heart.
  9. Surely his salvation is near to those who fear him: * that glory may dwell in our land.
  10. Mercy and truth have met each other: * justice and peace have kissed.
  11. Truth is sprung out of the earth: * and justice has looked down from heaven.
  12. For the Lord will give goodness: * and our earth shall yield her fruit.
  13. Justice shall walk before him: * and shall set his steps in the way.
  14. Glory be...

blocks.chantTranslation:
The bodies of the Saints//were buried in peace,
and their names shall live for ever.
Martyrs of the Lord,//bless the Lord for ever.
_Can. Isa._  Truly you are a hidden God,//the God of Israel, the Saviour.

blocks.text:
1. Confúsi sunt, et erubuérunt omnes: * simul abiérunt in confusiónem fabricatóres errórum.
  2. Israël salvátus est in Dómino salúte ætérna: * non confundémini, et non erubescétis usque in sǽculum sǽculi.
  3. Quia hæc dicit Dóminus creans cælos, * ipse Deus formans terram, et fáciens eam, ipse plastes eius:
  4. Non in vanum creávit eam, ut habitarétur, formávit eam: * Ego Dóminus, et non est álius.
  5. Non in abscóndito locútus sum, * in loco terræ tenebróso:
  6. Non dixi sémini Jacob frustra: Quǽrite me: * ego Dóminus loquens iustítiam, annúntians recta.
  7. Congregámini, et veníte, et accédite simul * qui salváti estis ex géntibus:
  8. Nesciérunt qui levant lignum sculptúræ suæ, * et rogant deum non salvántem.
  9. Annuntiáte, et veníte, et consiliámini simul: * Quis audítum fecit hoc ab inítio, ex tunc prædíxit illud?
  10. Numquid non ego Dóminus, et non est ultra Deus absque me? * Deus iustus, et salvans non est præter me.
  11. Convertímini ad me, et salvi éritis, omnes fines terræ: * quia ego Deus, et non est álius.
  12. In memetípso iurávi, egrediétur de ore meo iustítiæ verbum, * et non revertétur:
  13. Quia mihi curvábitur omne genu, * et iurábit omnis lingua.
  14. Ergo in Dómino, dicet, meæ sunt iustítiæ et impérium: * ad eum vénient, et confundéntur omnes qui repúgnant ei.
  15. In Dómino iustificábitur, et laudábitur * omne semen Israël.
  16. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
  17. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
blocks.translation:
1. All are confounded and put to shame: * the makers of idols have gone away together in confusion.
  2. Israel is saved by the Lord with an everlasting salvation: * you shall not be confounded nor ashamed for ever and ever.
  3. For thus says the Lord, who created the heavens, * the God himself who formed the earth and made it, who established it:
  4. He did not create it in vain, but formed it to be inhabited: * I am the Lord, and there is no other.
  5. I have not spoken in secret, * in a dark place of the earth;
  6. I have not said to the seed of Jacob in vain: Seek me: * I am the Lord speaking justice, declaring right things.
  7. Gather yourselves, and come, and draw near together, * you who are saved from among the nations:
  8. They have not known who lift up the wood of their graven work, * and pray to a god that cannot save.
  9. Declare it, and come, and take counsel together: * who has made this known from the beginning, and foretold it from that time?
  10. Have not I the Lord, and there is no other God beside me? * a just God and a Saviour; there is none beside me.
  11. Turn to me and you shall be saved, all the ends of the earth: * for I am God, and there is no other.
  12. I have sworn by myself; the word of justice shall go forth from my mouth, * and shall not return:
  13. That every knee shall bow to me, * and every tongue shall swear.
  14. Therefore it shall be said: In the Lord are my justices and empire: * to him they shall come, and all who resist him shall be confounded.
  15. In the Lord all the seed of Israel shall be justified and praised.
  16. Glory be...

blocks.chantTranslation: Martyrs of the Lord,//bless the Lord for ever.
Choir of martyrs,//praise the Lord in the highest.
_Ps. 147_  Praise the Lord, O Jerusalem://praise your God, O Sion.

blocks.text:
1. Quóniam confortávit seras portárum tuárum: * benedíxit fíliis tuis in te.
  2. Qui pósuit fines tuos pacem: * et ádipe fruménti sátiat te.
  3. Qui emíttit elóquium suum terræ: * velóciter currit sermo eius.
  4. Qui dat nivem sicut lanam: * nébulam sicut cínerem spargit.
  5. Mittit crystállum suam sicut buccéllas: * ante fáciem frígoris eius quis sustinébit?
  6. Emíttet verbum suum, et liquefáciet ea: * flabit spíritus eius, et fluent aquæ.
  7. Qui annúntiat verbum suum Jacob: * iustítias, et iudícia sua Israël.
  8. Non fecit táliter omni natióni: * et iudícia sua non manifestávit eis.
  9. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
  10. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
blocks.translation:
1. For he has strengthened the bolts of your gates: * he has blessed your children within you.
  2. He has established peace in your borders: * and fills you with the finest wheat.
  3. He sends forth his command to the earth: * his word runs swiftly.
  4. He gives snow like wool: * he scatters hoarfrost like ashes.
  5. He casts forth his ice like morsels: * who can stand before the cold?
  6. He shall send out his word, and melt them: * his wind shall blow, and the waters shall flow.
  7. He declares his word to Jacob: * his justices and his judgments to Israel.
  8. He has not done so with every nation: * and his judgments he has not made manifest to them.
  9. Glory be...

blocks.chantTranslation: Choir of martyrs,//praise the Lord in the highest.

The night has passed, and the day has drawn near. Therefore let us cast off the works of darkness
and put on the armour of light. Let us walk becomingly, as in the daytime.
\R. Thanks be to God.

O glorious King of martyrs,//crown of confessors,
you who lead to heavenly things those who spurn the things of earth,
Quickly incline your gracious ear//to our prayers:
we sing your sacred triumphs, //forgive the sins we have committed.
You conquer in your martyrs//by sparing your confessors;
so conquer now our sins//by granting us your mercy.
Glory be to God the Father, //and to his only Son,
with the Holy Spirit, the Comforter, now and for evermore. Amen.

\V. The Saints shall exult in glory.
\R. They shall rejoice//in their resting places.

All the hairs of your head//have been numbered;
do not be afraid: you are worth more than many sparrows.
_Can. Zac._  Blessed be the Lord//God of Israel,
for he has visited//and redeemed his people.

blocks.text:
1. Et eréxit cornu salútis nobis: * in domo David, púeri sui.
  2. Sicut locútus est per os sanctórum, * qui a sǽculo sunt, prophetárum eius:
  3. Salútem ex inimícis nostris, * et de manu ómnium, qui odérunt nos.

  4. Ad faciéndam misericórdiam cum pátribus nostris: * et memorári testaménti sui sancti.
  5. Jusiurándum, quod iurávit ad Abraham patrem nostrum, * datúrum se nobis:
  6. Ut sine timóre, de manu inimicórum nostrórum liberáti, * serviámus illi.
  7. In sanctitáte, et iustítia coram ipso, * ómnibus diébus nostris.
  8. Et tu, puer, Prophéta Altíssimi vocáberis: * præíbis enim ante fáciem Dómini, paráre vias eius:
  9. Ad dandam sciéntiam salútis plebi eius: * in remissiónem peccatórum eórum:
  10. Per víscera misericórdiæ Dei nostri: * in quibus visitávit nos, óriens ex alto:
  11. Illumináre his, qui in ténebris, et in umbra mortis sedent: * ad dirigéndos pedes nostros in viam pacis.
  12. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
  13. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
blocks.translation:
1. And has raised up a horn of salvation for us * in the house of David his servant,
  2. As he spoke by the mouth of his holy prophets, * who have been from of old:
  3. Salvation from our enemies, * and from the hand of all who hate us;

  4. To show mercy to our fathers, * and to remember his holy covenant,
  5. The oath which he swore to Abraham our father, * to grant unto us,
  6. That, being delivered from the hand of our enemies, * we might serve him without fear,
  7. In holiness and righteousness before him, * all our days.
  8. And you, child, shall be called the Prophet of the Most High; * for you shall go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways,
  9. To give knowledge of salvation to his people * through the forgiveness of their sins,
  10. Through the tender mercy of our God, * whereby the Dayspring from on high has visited us,
  11. To give light to those who sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, * to guide our feet into the way of peace.
  12. Glory be...

blocks.chantTranslation:
All the hairs of your head//have been numbered;
do not be afraid: you are worth more than many sparrows.

blocks.chantTranslation:
\V. The Lord be with you.//\R. And with your spirit. Let us pray.
O God, who grant us to celebrate the heavenly birthday of your holy martyrs Rufina and Secunda,
grant that in everlasting blessedness we may rejoice in their companionship.
Through our Lord Jesus Christ...


\R. Amen.
\V. The Lord be with you.//\R. And with your spirit.

\V. Let us bless the Lord.
\R. Thanks be to God.

blocks.text: The officiant continues in a low voice:

blocks.chantTranslation:
\V. May the souls of the faithful, through the mercy of God,//rest in peace.
\R. Amen.
